name: Failed Logon Burst Then Success Within Five Minutes
description: Three failed logons (4625) followed by a success (4624) where each step is within five minutes of the one before. The unbounded version of this pattern pairs failures with a success that may be days later, which is a very different claim; bounding the gaps is what makes it read as one burst. It does NOT establish that the failures and the success concern the same account — a failed logon creates no session, so there is no session id to correlate on, and the account name on a 4625 is attacker-supplied.
